message: Boundary grants s3:GetObject and s3:ListBucket on Resource: * — created role can read any S3 bucket in the account, creating a data-exfiltration surface

Boundary Allow statement 'unnamed' grants cross-account-capable actions (s3:GetObject, s3:ListBucket) without aws:ResourceAccount condition. The created role could access resources in other accounts if cross-account resource policies permit it. Add "StringEquals": {"aws:ResourceAccount": "${aws:PrincipalAccount}"} to restrict to same-account.
